notes: 10 samples (titles *_ribo) are ribosome profiling (MNase footprints) -> assay_class ribosome_footprints. GLU4 wild type has no named lineage in the text, so strain_group left empty. Temperature and aeration not stated. Phase inferred from OD 0.3 in M9; paraquat samples 20 min later keep it.

carbon_source.q: M9 minimal media with 0.4% glucose w/v as a carbon source

growth_phase.q: At A600 OD = 0.3 paraquat was added

inducer_added.q: Transcriptomics was performed on 2 end point strains and WT with and without addition of paraquat.

transcription_arrested.q: Transcriptomics was performed on 2 end point strains and WT with and without addition of paraquat.

mixed_organism.q: Transcriptomics was performed on 2 end point strains and WT with and without addition of paraquat.

is_control.q: Transcriptomics was performed on 2 end point strains and WT with and without addition of paraquat.

assay_class.q: Ribosomal RNA was depleted using Illumina's Ribo-Zero rRNA removal kit and libraries were constructed using KAPA RNA-Seq Library Preparation kit

rrna_removal.q: Ribosomal RNA was depleted using Illumina's Ribo-Zero rRNA removal kit

exposure.q: Cells were harvested 20mins after addition of paraquat

genotype_class.q: GLU4 is the wild type strain

global_regulator_perturbed.q: GLU4 is the wild type strain

genotype_class.q: PQ1 and PQ2 are end-point strains from an adaptive laboratory evolution (ALE)

assay_class.q: MNase was used to shear RNA leaving behind ribosome protected regions.
